chunks: And wait; they will come to know soon.

key_terms.يُبْصِرُونَ: They will come to know / They will see clearly

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'And wait; they will come to know soon' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a command for the Prophet to observe the disbelievers' gradual decline in faith, serving as a precursor to their ultimate realization of divine truth. It underscores the concept of 'tadarruj' (gradualness) in divine punishment and reward, highlighting that the current state of denial is temporary and will inevitably give way to clear recognition. This perspective reinforces the believer's patience (sabr) by framing historical events as part of a divinely ordained trajectory toward justice.
